origins.section: A Polyhedron Is Convex: The Segment Between Two Feasible Points Stays Feasible
Extreme Points Are Where Two Rows Are Tight at Once
Yes/No Decisions Break Convexity, and That Is Why Integer Programming Is Hard

recorded.outcome:q-fraction: But the polyhedron has other corners too, fractional ones, and here the best corner is one of those.
